name: expense-api
description: Owns expense claims and their approval lifecycle: creation, editing of rejected claims, manager approve/reject, and finance export to a payroll CSV. Also owns the minimal employee/manager directory needed to route a claim to its submitter's manager. The optional receipt attachment is stored inline as base64 content on the claim record in this service's own database — no separate object storage dependency. Does not send email and does not integrate with a specific payroll vendor API.

dependencies.name: expense-db
dependencies.description: Stores expense claims (including the receipt file content), their status history, and the lightweight employee/manager directory this project owns (no org directory service is registered).

dependencies.name: thunder-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the bearer token on every request; the gateway injects X-User-Id/X-User-Name/X-User-Groups from it.
